## Findings
- claim-1: The required explicit identities for \(\rho=(2,2)\) and \(\rho=(3,3)\) have not been obtained from the supplied material.
- claim-2: The required \(\rho=(3,3)\) target has sign \(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\), since \(|(3,3)|=6\).
## Strategy
Set \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,5}\),
\[
J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda,
\qquad A_+=\bigoplus_{d>0}A_d .
\]
The missing \(\rho=(2,2)\) case is certified. Here
\[
L_{22}=\bar s_{33322},\qquad R_{22}=\bar s_{553},
\]
and truncated Pieri gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
h_1\bar s_{4332}&=\bar s_{5332}+\bar s_{4432}+\bar s_{4333}+\bar s_{43321},\\
h_1\bar s_{3333}&=\bar s_{4333}+\bar s_{33331},\\
h_2\bar s_{533}&=\bar s_{553}+\bar s_{5431}+\bar s_{5332},\\
h_3\bar s_{433}&=\bar s_{5431}+\bar s_{5332}+\bar s_{4432}+\bar s_{4333},\\
h_2\bar s_{3332}&=\bar s_{5332}+\bar s_{4333}+\bar s_{43321}
+\bar s_{33331}+\bar s_{33322}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore coefficientwise cancellation yields the integral identity
\[
\boxed{
\bar s_{553}-\bar s_{33322}
=h_1\bar s_{4332}+h_1\bar s_{3333}
+h_2\bar s_{533}-h_3\bar s_{433}-h_2\bar s_{3332}.
}
\]
Every right factor lies in \(J\), and \(t\in\{1,2,3\}\).

## Gaps
The required \(\rho=(3,3)\) identity
\[
\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\in A_+J
\]
has not been supplied. Consequently, neither the requested all-\(\rho\) certificate nor the requested complete ten-case Pieri verification is established. The corrected sign is minus.
